title: Out of Darkness Into the Light

paragraphs.text: Allah revealed the Qur'an as clear Arabic guidance. Messengers before also had wives and children. No messenger brought a sign without Allah's permission. Allah removes or confirms what He wills, and with Him is the Mother of the Book. The Prophet's duty is only to deliver the message. Allah judges, and no one can change His decision. When the disbelievers say, "You are not a messenger," Allah is enough as Witness.

Surah Ibrahim begins. This Book was revealed to bring people out of darkness into light. Woe to those who prefer this world over the Hereafter. Every messenger spoke the language of his people, so he could explain clearly.

Allah sent Moses to bring his people into the light. Moses reminded them how Allah saved them from Pharaoh's people. Those people killed their sons and caused great pain. Allah declared, "If you are grateful, I will give you more. But if you deny, My punishment is severe." Allah does not need anyone.

The people of Noah, 'Aad and Thamud doubted their messengers. The messengers asked, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth?" But the people said, "You are only men like us."

hardWords.m: to bring and give to someone
